note: Hosts, versions and paths come from twilio-oai spec/json (release 2.10.0). Status, EOL dates and migration targets come from Twilio changelog/docs pages cited per product. The OAI spec carries no deprecation markers, so a product being in the spec does NOT mean it is supported (Chat, Notify, Proxy, Frontline are still listed).

products.name: Accounts (credentials, auth token rotation, safelist)

products.name: Core REST API (Accounts, Messages, Calls, Recordings, IncomingPhoneNumbers, ...)
products.note: 2010-04-01 is the only supported version of the core API. The older 2008 version reached End of Life on 2023-12-15 (migrate to 2010-04-01). 2010 endpoints return XML by default; append .json for JSON.
